title: uno: Multiplayer UNO Game in R
text: game logic handled two main functions: -play_game() – Runs full game start finish -play_turns_loop() – Internal engine manages turns, checks playable cards, handles actions, tracks winner game proceeds automatically one player finishes cards. draw pile runs , game ends draw.

title: uno: Multiplayer UNO Game in R
text: game runs automatically one player wins emptying hand. actions (skip, draw, reverse) handled engine. Note: Wild cards (wild, wild_draw4) appear discard pile color selected player played . example, card value = “wild” color = “green” means player played wild chose green.

what: Simulate and Score a Game of UNO
title: Simulate and Score a Game of UNO
text: uno R package simulates full multiplayer UNO game using realistic card rules automated gameplay. Designed part Monash ETC Advanced R course, package allows players experience turn--turn logic, action card effects, winner detection, within reproducible testable R environment. Developed Team Kookaburras.

title: Simulate and Score a Game of UNO
text: Install development version directly GitHub:
code: # Install devtools if not already installed install.packages("devtools")  # Install uno package from GitHub devtools::install_github("MonashARP/game-package-kookaburras", subdir = "uno")

title: Simulate and Score a Game of UNO
text: Generates full UNO deck (108 cards) Deals cards fairly players Handles action wild cards Simulates turn--turn game logic Detects winner deck exhaustion Includes internal game loop control Documented unit-tested

what: Create a Standard UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
title: Create a Standard UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
text: Builds complete 108-card UNO deck used standard game. four colors — red, green, blue, yellow — includes: One 0 card Two copies cards numbered 1 9 Two copies action cards: skip, reverse, +2 Additionally, deck includes eight uncolored wild cards: Four wild cards Four wild_draw4 cards

title: Create a Standard UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
code: create_uno_deck()

title: Create a Standard UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
text: tibble 108 rows 3 columns: color Card color — one "red", "green", "blue", "yellow", "wild" value Card face value — numbers "0" "9", action names type Card type — either "number", "action", "wild"

title: Create a Standard UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
text: function typically used first step game setup, returns tidy tibble containing card data.

title: Create a Standard UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
code: # Generate and inspect the deck deck <- create_uno_deck() dim(deck)         # Should return 108 rows, 3 columns #> [1] 108   3 table(deck$type)  # Count of card types #>  #> action number   wild  #>     24     76      8  head(deck)        # Preview the top of the deck #> # A tibble: 6 × 3 #>   color value type   #>   <chr> <chr> <chr>  #> 1 red   0     number #> 2 red   1     number #> 3 red   1     number #> 4 red   2     number #> 5 red   2     number #> 6 red   3     number  # Filter for wild cards deck[deck$type == "wild", ] #> # A tibble: 8 × 3 #>   color value      type  #>   <chr> <chr>      <chr> #> 1 wild  wild       wild  #> 2 wild  wild       wild  #> 3 wild  wild       wild  #> 4 wild  wild       wild  #> 5 wild  wild_draw4 wild  #> 6 wild  wild_draw4 wild  #> 7 wild  wild_draw4 wild  #> 8 wild  wild_draw4 wild   # Count how many of each card value exist table(deck$value) #>  #>         +2          0          1          2          3          4          5  #>          8          4          8          8          8          8          8  #>          6          7          8          9    reverse       skip       wild  #>          8          8          8          8          8          8          4  #> wild_draw4  #>          4   # Filter just the blue action cards subset(deck, color == "blue" & type == "action") #> # A tibble: 6 × 3 #>   color value   type   #>   <chr> <chr>   <chr>  #> 1 blue  skip    action #> 2 blue  skip    action #> 3 blue  reverse action #> 4 blue  reverse action #> 5 blue  +2      action #> 6 blue  +2      action

text: n_players Number players game (must ≥ 2). Default 4.

code: score_game(game_state)

title: Compute and Display Final UNO Scores — score_game
text: game_state named list returned play_game() containing: hands – named list tibbles, representing player's final hand. winner – Character string winning player (e.g., "Player_2"), NULL winner. reason – Optional message explaining game ended (e.g., deck exhausted).

title: Compute and Display Final UNO Scores — score_game
text: tibble 3 columns: Player Character. Player name (e.g., "Player_1", "Player_2", ...) Cards_Remaining Integer. Number cards remaining player’s hand. Result Character. "🏆 Winner" winning player, blank others. summary tibble returned invisibly (useful programmatic scoring), results also printed.

title: Compute and Display Final UNO Scores — score_game
text: function typically called simulating full game using play_game(). addition returning summary tibble, prints formatted score table final hands player transparency post-game analysis. - player's hand evaluated counting remaining cards.  - output tibble ranks players lowest highest card count.  - result printed user-friendly format showing winner final hands.  - ideal logging, leaderboard generation, simulation diagnostics. Note: winner exists (e.g., deck ran ), warning message shown.

what: Initialize a UNO Game Session — setup_game
title: Initialize a UNO Game Session — setup_game
text: Sets playable UNO game state generating complete deck, shuffling , dealing 7 cards player, drawing first discard card, initializing gameplay direction player turn order.

title: Initialize a UNO Game Session — setup_game
code: setup_game(n_players)

title: Initialize a UNO Game Session — setup_game
text: n_players Integer. Number players initialize. Must ≥ 2. Default 4.  version supports dynamic randomization direction starting player. Note: Future versions may restore support deterministic turn order clockwise play default, options override.

title: Initialize a UNO Game Session — setup_game
text: named list: hands – Named list player hands (tibble 7 cards) deck – Remaining deck (dealing discard) discard – One-row tibble top discard card direction – Integer: 1 -1 turn – Integer: randomly chosen starting player's index

title: Initialize a UNO Game Session — setup_game
text: function typically first step calling play_turns_loop play_game simulate full game. - Shuffles deck create_uno_deck  - Deals 7 cards player  - One card drawn first discard  - Direction randomly chosen (1 = clockwise, -1 = counter-clockwise)  - Starting player randomly selected available players
